Name: Jerahmeel, Son of Kish
Summary: Son of Kish in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:29: Son of Kish in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jerahmeel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
